asena: Grey female wolf, four canine legs and bushy tail, mountain cave; no hybrid anatomy.
ayakashi-yokai: Extremely long continuous sea-serpent body, one snake head, no limbs; boat shows scale.
azhdaha: One huge serpentine body with bright-eyed reptilian head and broad tooth-filled mouth, no wings or legs.
baca-mythological-creature: Large entirely black dog, one canine head and four canine legs; dog familiar variant.
anzu: Single lion head and mane, feathered avian body, two bird legs, two feathered wings; no lion quadruped body.
aoandon: Adult female blue skin, two horns, pointed teeth, Japanese robe and blue lantern.
aosaginohi: Heron neck, beak, two slender legs, glowing eyes and wing feathers without a burning body.
apophis: Single huge snake head, continuous scaled body, no limbs, Nile-like desert river setting.
amarum: Boa-like head and continuous coiled snake body in a rainy Amazon river setting; no limbs or wings.
anansi: Human face on compact spider body, eight spider legs without additional human arms.
anggitay: Adult female human torso and arms joined to a complete four-legged horse body, one horse tail.
anhanga: White deer with four slender legs and fiery glowing eyes, natural deer form without wings.
